lyrics:
[Intro: warm piano chords, room noise, a message beep]

[Spoken: woman's voice note, natural, unhurried]
Hey. I was just thinking.
You know what I missed? It wasn't the big stuff.
It wasn't the trips or the parties.

[Spoken: piano continues, soft kick enters]
It was sitting around. With everybody.
Nothing in particular. Somebody's kid in the pool.
Somebody burning something on the grill.

[Refrain: sung softly, voices layered]
Sitting around, sitting around
With everybody
Nothing to do, and all of you
With everybody

[Drop: full beat, piano and bass, vocal chop of "everybody"]

[Spoken: voice warmer, hi-hats in]
And we've got it back. Look.
I'm looking at it right now.
So. Come over. Bring nothing.

[Refrain: sung, fuller, handclaps]
Sitting around, sitting around
With everybody
Nothing to do, and all of you
With everybody

[Drop: biggest, strings on top, vocal chop]

[Outro: piano alone, spoken]
Okay. That's all. Love you. Bye.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 123 BPM, 4/4, C major. Warm, gathering and quietly euphoric, a slow sunrise of a track.

VOICE: A woman in her fifties speaking naturally into a phone, with pauses, a small laugh and room noise left in. The refrain is sung by soft, layered male and female voices. The word 'everybody' is chopped and pitched in the drops.

INSTRUMENTS: A felt-damped upright piano playing warm, repeating chords, a soft kick that enters late, a round sub bass, shuffled hi-hats, handclaps, a string section in the second drop, the vocal chop, a message beep.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and beep. 0:12 Spoken part 1. 0:36 Spoken part 2, kick in. 1:00 Refrain 1. 1:24 Drop 1. 1:50 Spoken part 3. 2:12 Refrain 2. 2:36 Drop 2, strings. 3:02 Outro, piano and the sign-off at 3:10.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2021 emotional house: lo-fi voice-note vocal against warm, full piano and a soft modern beat. Intimate first, wide later.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'So. Come over. Bring nothing.' at 2:06.

STATION FIT: 5 p.m., when friends arrive. The most emotional track of the day set, and the one most like the voice-led records these stations favour.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Musing, missing, noticing, inviting.
